about: Extra sound-effect packs for the audio library, fetched from their creators' sites the first time a mix, a search or `showtime audio packs fetch` needs them (never re-hosted). Each pack is pinned by URL, size and sha256; its license was checked on the creator's page (evidence). CC0 packs need no credit; CC BY packs carry the exact credit, which `audio mix` writes into credits.txt.

opengameart.org.rule: direct file links from each pack page; one pack per request, 10 s apart (the site asks for gentle use)

bigsoundbank.com.rule: direct /UPLOAD/ogg/<n>.ogg links; every page states CC0

upload.wikimedia.org.rule: Commons file URLs; send a descriptive User-Agent (SHOWTIME_CONTACT adds a contact) and back off on HTTP 429
